codes.invalid_argument: An argument the tool does not declare, a value of the wrong type, a missing required argument, or a combination the tool refuses: an address that matches no node, a prefix bound twice, two columns with the same label, a metric other than `count` with no column. The message names the problem. For an undeclared or mistyped argument the recovery lists the arguments the tool accepts.
codes.invalid_cursor: `cursor` is not a token this tool returned, belongs to a different tool, or is more than ten minutes old. Call the tool again without a cursor.
codes.stale_cursor: The document changed between two pages of the same read. Start again without a cursor.
codes.query_not_supported: `select_xpath` was given something outside XPath 1.0 as this engine provides it: a function from XPath 2.0 or later, or the namespace axis, whose nodes the engine cannot report. `describe_document` lists every namespace instead.
codes.resource_limit: The request would exceed a fixed budget: parsing took longer than two seconds, too many reads are already queued, or too many `list_documents` calls are running. See [Limits](/docs/xml-mcp/limits).

codes.path_outside_root: `filePath` resolves outside the folder the server was started with. Paths are relative to that folder, and `..` cannot leave it.
codes.file_not_found: No file exists at `filePath`. Call `list_documents` for the paths that do.
codes.not_a_file: `filePath` names a directory or another entry that is not a regular file.
codes.unsupported_extension: The file's extension is not one the server reads: `.xml`, `.xsd`, `.xhtml`, `.svg`, `.csproj`, `.props`, `.targets`, `.config` or `.resx`.
codes.file_too_large: The file is over the 50 MB ceiling. Between 8 MB and 50 MB a document is read in chunked mode instead.
codes.file_changed: The file was modified while it was being read. Retry the call.
codes.unsupported_platform: The native package that gives the server safe file access is missing for this operating system and CPU. Reinstall on a supported platform.

codes.malformed_xml: The document, or one record of a chunked document, is not well-formed XML. A file with an XML extension is a candidate, not a guarantee; `.config` files in particular are often not XML.
codes.doctype_not_allowed: The document has a DOCTYPE declaration. The server refuses every DOCTYPE before parsing, because an internal DTD subset can expand entities that no parser flag fully blocks. Remove the declaration to read the file.
codes.unsupported_encoding: The document is encoded in a UCS-4 or EBCDIC family, which the server cannot read. Re-encode it as UTF-8 or UTF-16.
codes.numeric_precision: `aggregate_document` met a value with more digits than a binary64 number holds, so `sum`, `avg`, `min` or `max` would change it. Use a counting metric, or project the rows and total them elsewhere.
codes.unsupported_for_format: The tool needs the whole document in memory and this document is read in chunked mode because it is over 8 MB. `select_xpath`, `find_in_document` and `aggregate_document` are unavailable there; `project_records` still works.

codes.internal_error: A defect in the server, not in your document or your call. This is the one code with no `recovery`, because there is no next call that fixes it. The detail is written to the server's stderr.

keys.residentMaxBytes: Largest document read whole into memory; a larger one is read in chunked mode
keys.maxChunkBytes: Largest single record in chunked mode
keys.maxLiveChunkDoms: Records of a chunked document held parsed at once
keys.maxParseMs: Time one parse may take before it fails with `resource_limit`
keys.maxDomDepth: Deepest element nesting an address may reach
keys.prologScanBytes: Bytes at the start of a document scanned for its encoding and a DOCTYPE before parsing
keys.maxQueueDepth: Parse requests that may wait at once before a new one fails with `resource_limit`
keys.documentCacheSize: Parsed documents kept in memory between calls
keys.workerCacheEntries: Documents the parse worker keeps alive, derived as twice `documentCacheSize`
keys.maxListScan: Directory entries `list_documents` walks before it reports `scanTruncated`
keys.maxConcurrentListings: `list_documents` calls that may run at once

keys.maxPayloadBytes: Largest serialized answer; a longer one is cut short and continues through `nextCursor`
keys.maxStringChars: Longest text, in characters, returned for one node or value
keys.defaultDescribePaths: Repeated-element candidates `describe_document` returns when `maxPaths` is omitted
keys.maxDescribeVisits: Elements `describe_document` counts before it stops and reports the survey incomplete

keys.maxFindVisits: Nodes `find_in_document` examines before it stops and reports the search incomplete
keys.maxNamespaceBindings: Prefix bindings one `select_xpath` call may pass
keys.defaultXpathResults: Node-set members `select_xpath` returns when `maxResults` is omitted

keys.maxColumns: Columns one `project_records` or `aggregate_document` call may declare
keys.maxItemVisits: Records one `project_records` or `aggregate_document` call examines before it stops and reports the scan incomplete

hidden.catalogTtlMs: a cache hint on the `tools/list` answer, not a limit on a call
hidden.maxFileBytes: the file layer's ceiling; `maxXmlBytes` is the same value and is what this server enforces
